limits: Partial-reference assessment of legacy changed-target products is reviewed separately when its post-run report is complete.
Versioned assay correction changes intended endpoints; old41-to-new1 is not an unchanged-assay retention regression.
Reference equality does not establish full sample phasing; Acer opalus is a related-species proxy for the Acer sample.
These finite local gates do not establish held-out or all-panel biological performance, final macOS results, laptop performance, collaborator acceptance or release authorization.
method: Independent checks of saved raw files, literal sequences, outcomes, counts, diagnostics, constraints and receipts; no test or assembly rerun.
